title: Guided micro-journeys for Console setup and cost literacy
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: New users land in the Redwood Console with high-level dashboards and cost metrics but often don't know how to interpret token/cost breakdowns, configure rollouts, or pick an initial project template. Current empty states are static and require users to navigate docs outside the product.

Goal: Create a set of lightweight, in-product micro-journeys that guide first-time users through 3 core tasks: 1) create a seed project and understand cost implications, 2) configure a rollout with a canary and fallback, and 3) read token-level cost breakdowns on a sample trace. These journeys should be discoverable from empty states, optionally skippable, and measured for completion and downstream retention.

Scope: Design of UI flows, copy, tooltip content, inline templates, and two interactive prototypes (desktop & tablet). Hand off assets for engineering and PM, and iterate after an initial usability study with 8 participants. Not in scope: backend analytics wiring (dependency), deep localization (defer to next sprint).
acceptance_criteria: Three micro-journeys implemented as annotated design screens with responsive variants
Prototype links shared and tested in a moderated usability session (n>=8) with at least 75% task completion for each journey
Copy reviewed and signed off by PM and Content Design
Empty state components updated with CTA to launch guided journeys
Design tokens and component variants documented for engineering handoff
comments: 2025-11-06 Aisha: Initial discovery completed. Interview notes from early adopters attached in Drive (see design_links). Top pain: users don't trust cost cards without a quick demo mode.
2025-11-09 Luca: Proposed a progressive disclosure approach — ‘Learn mode’ that overlays explanations and allows users to toggle live vs demo data. Mockups added to the prototype.
2025-11-11 PM Maya: Add a brief checklist metric that surfaces whether a user has completed the cost literacy journey; will be used by Growth to experiment with email nudges.
2025-11-14 Research Mateo: Usability study plan ready. Recruiting 8 participants with prior LLM infra experience and 4 novice product engineers.
2025-11-18 Content Priya: Draft microcopy for tooltips uploaded. Need microcopy sign-off from legal for any sample billing numbers.
decisions: Use demo-mode sample traces (synthetic data) by default for first two steps to avoid leaking customer data
Primary CTA on empty state will be 'Try guided setup' (secondary: 'Create project')
Tooltips will be contextually pinned for 3 screens and dismissible per session
Rollout configuration guide will include a recommended canary at 10% with an automatic 5-minute observation window as the default suggestion
